description: Configure VSCode to automatically recognize custom file extensions. Add the following file associations to VSCode user settings: (1) Pattern '*.svcconfig' should map to language mode 'yaml', (2) Pattern '*.route' should map to language mode 'jsonc', (3) Pattern '*.tpl.html' should map to language mode 'html'. These associations should be added to the 'files.associations' setting in VSCode user settings. You can do this by: opening Settings (Ctrl+,), searching for 'file associations', and adding each pattern-to-language mapping, OR by directly editing settings.json to add a 'files.associations' object with these three mappings. The workspace contains sample files with these extensions that currently lack syntax highlighting.
